name: StormBurger
facts: Locations: Inglewood (1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302) and Long Beach (5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805). Compton (336 W Alondra Blvd, Compton, CA 90220) is coming soon.
Inglewood hours: Sun–Thu 10:30 AM–12 AM, Fri–Sat 10:30 AM–1 AM.
Long Beach hours: Mon–Wed 10:30 AM–10 PM, Thu–Sun 10:30 AM–11 PM.
Storm Run is a 45-second driving game with 5 lives. It is free to play with no account needed.
An account is only needed to save your score or claim a prize after a run.
Score prizes: 400 = free house sauce, 600 = free fries or onion rings, 800 = free milkshake, 1,000 = free Classic StormBurger.
Weekly top score (Monday to Sunday close) wins a Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo. The board resets every Monday.
Only one game prize at a time per member. Use it within 3 days.
Daily Spin: one free spin per member per day (Los Angeles time). Every slice wins something.
Rewards earn 20 points per $1 spent.
Reward ladder: 1,000 pts = free fries, 1,800 = free shake, 3,000 = free Classic StormBurger, 4,500 = free combo.
Bonuses: +50 daily check-in, +100 first order, +200 birthday, +250 for in-app feedback.
Referral: you get 150 points when a friend joins; your friend gets 50 points and free fries.
Combos come with fries and a soft drink. Upgrade fries to onion rings +$2.00, or the drink to a milkshake +$2.00.
Classic StormBurger Combo $11.99; Jalapeño Lightning Burger Combo $13.99; Kids Combo $11.99; Chicken Sandwich Combo $12.99.
Sauces are homemade, $1.00 each.
Players must be 13+; under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's permission. One account per person and per phone.
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.
Opt-in texts and emails can be stopped anytime by replying STOP or unsubscribing.
Food prizes and discounts work at either location, one reward per visit, no cash value, not combinable with other rewards.
No prize includes alcohol.
The app has a language menu (🌐) at the top right.
No phone number is shown in the app. Ask at the counter.
suggested: What rewards can I get and how many points do they cost?
How do I play Storm Run and what can I win?
How does the free daily spin work?

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Inglewood: Sun–Thu 10:30 AM–12 AM, Fri–Sat 10:30 AM–1 AM. Long Beach: Mon–Wed 10:30 AM–10 PM, Thu–Sun 10:30 AM–11 PM.

qa.q: What time do you open?
qa.a: Both locations open at 10:30 AM every day.

qa.q: How late are you open in Inglewood?
qa.a: Inglewood is open until 12 AM Sunday to Thursday and 1 AM Friday and Saturday.

qa.q: How late are you open in Long Beach?
qa.a: Long Beach closes at 10 PM Monday to Wednesday and 11 PM Thursday to Sunday.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: Inglewood: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302. Long Beach: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805. Compton is coming soon.

qa.q: What is your Inglewood address?
qa.a: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302.

qa.q: What is your Long Beach address?
qa.a: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805.

qa.q: Are you opening in Compton?
qa.a: Yes, Compton is coming soon at 336 W Alondra Blvd, Compton, CA 90220. I don't have an opening date.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the Directions button under the location you want in the app.

qa.q: What is your phone number?
qa.a: I don't have a phone number for you. Please ask at the counter.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff at the location.

qa.q: Do you have a drive-thru?
qa.a: I don't have that detail. Please ask staff at the location.

qa.q: How do I order?
qa.a: Tap Order Inglewood or Order Long Beach in the app. You can also build your own burger or chicken sandwich in the app.

qa.q: Can I order from my table?
qa.a: The app is set up to open from a table QR code. For how table ordering works, ask staff.

qa.q: Can I pay in the app?
qa.a: I don't have details on paying in the app. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Do you do delivery?
qa.a: I don't have delivery details. Tap an Order button in the app or ask staff.

qa.q: How do I sign up or join rewards?
qa.a: Join StormBurger Rewards with your name, phone number and email. You can also join after a game run when you save your score.

qa.q: Is it free to join?
qa.a: Yes. A member account is free.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play the game?
qa.a: No. Storm Run is free for anyone with no account. You only need one to save your score or claim a prize.

qa.q: Can I have more than one account?
qa.a: No. It's one free account per person and per phone.

qa.q: How old do I have to be?
qa.a: You must be 13 or older. If you're under 18 you need a parent's or guardian's permission.

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: You earn 20 points for every $1 you spend. You also get bonuses for checking in, your first order, your birthday, feedback and referrals.

qa.q: How many points per dollar?
qa.a: 20 points per $1 spent.

qa.q: How do I get my points when I buy?
qa.a: Show your member QR or code to the cashier at checkout. You can also type the code from your receipt.

qa.q: What is the daily check-in bonus?
qa.a: You get +50 points once a day when staff scan your member QR or code.

qa.q: Is there a first order bonus?
qa.a: Yes. Your first order earns +100 bonus points.

qa.q: Is there a birthday reward?
qa.a: Yes, you get +200 birthday points. Add your birthday to your member profile.

qa.q: Can I earn points for feedback?
qa.a: Yes. Leaving honest feedback in the app earns +250 points, whatever your rating is. Once per member.

qa.q: Do I get points for a Google review?
qa.a: No. There are no points or prizes for Google reviews. You can still write one honestly through the app's review button.

qa.q: How does the referral program work?
qa.a: When a friend joins with your code you get 150 points. Your friend gets 50 points and free fries. You can earn more when they order.

qa.q: What rewards can I get with points?
qa.a: 1,000 pts = free fries, 1,800 pts = free shake, 3,000 pts = free Classic StormBurger, 4,500 pts = free combo.

qa.q: How many points for free fries?
qa.a: 1,000 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free shake?
qa.a: 1,800 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free burger?
qa.a: 3,000 points gets you a free Classic StormBurger.

qa.q: How many points for a free combo?
qa.a: 4,500 points.

qa.q: How do I redeem my points?
qa.a: Pick a reward in the app and show it at the counter. I don't have more detail than that, so staff can help.

qa.q: Do I have a levels or tiers status?
qa.a: Yes. Levels are Member, Regular, VIP and Legend, based on how many visits you make in a month. Higher levels earn bonus points and perks, listed in the app.

qa.q: Do you have a welcome offer?
qa.a: Joining gets you a free fries offer with your next burger.

qa.q: Is there a nearby bonus?
qa.a: If you're near a StormBurger the app can show a heads-up. Show it at the counter for double stars on that day's order.

qa.q: Do my points expire?
qa.a: I don't have information about points expiring. Please ask staff.

qa.q: What is Storm Run?
qa.a: It's our driving game. You drive a food truck through a storm for 45 seconds, grabbing coins and StormBurger food while dodging hazards.

qa.q: How do I play Storm Run?
qa.a: Tap the left or right side of the road to change lanes. You can also use the ◀ ▶ buttons or the arrow keys on a computer.

qa.q: How long is a game?
qa.a: Each run is 45 seconds.

qa.q: How many lives do I have?
qa.a: 5 lives. Each hit costs half a life, so 10 hits and your truck is totaled.

qa.q: How does scoring work?
qa.a: Coins are +10. StormBurger food is +30 to +60. Flying cows, stop signs and lightning hits are −100 and cost half a life.

qa.q: How many points is each food worth?
qa.a: Classic StormBurger and Turkey Burger +60, Chicken Sandwich and Chicken Strips +50, Vanilla Shake and Lemonade +40, Fries and Onion Rings +30.

qa.q: What should I dodge?
qa.a: Lightning, flying cows, stop signs, police cars, small tornadoes, and the drive-thru line of cars.

qa.q: How does the lightning work?
qa.a: A glowing target appears on the road where lightning is about to strike, often right where your truck is. Change lanes before it lands.

qa.q: What is the pit stop or kitchen break?
qa.a: You can pull into the Jordan High pit stop for a 20-second kitchen break. Tap ingredients in the ticket's order to build burgers. Each finished burger is +75 points and repairs 1 life, up to 5.

qa.q: What are Antidote Drizzle emblems?
qa.a: Catch 5 of them (+25 each) to unlock Antidote's StormBurger review on a roadside billboard. Drive through its golden ▶ for +500 bonus points.

qa.q: What can I win in the game?
qa.a: Score 400 for a free house sauce, 600 for free fries or onion rings, 800 for a free milkshake, and 1,000 for a free Classic StormBurger.

qa.q: How do I get the free fries prize?
qa.a: Score 600 or more in one run. It's free fries or onion rings with any order.

qa.q: How do I win the free burger?
qa.a: Score over 1,000 points in a single run to win a free Classic StormBurger.

qa.q: How do I claim a game prize?
qa.a: After your run, save it to your rewards by joining or signing in. You'll get a code to show at StormBurger. You may be asked to show the code and your account at the counter.

qa.q: How long do I have to use a prize?
qa.a: Use a game prize within 3 days.

qa.q: Can I have more than one prize at once?
qa.a: No. It's one prize at a time per member. Use it before your next win saves.

qa.q: How often can I play?
qa.a: As often as you like. Storm Run is free and has no limit.

qa.q: Do I have to buy something to play?
qa.a: No. No purchase is needed to play, spin or win, and buying doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: Is the game skill or luck?
qa.a: It's a game of skill. Game prizes depend only on your score, not on chance.

qa.q: What is the weekly leaderboard?
qa.a: It's a weekly board of top scores. The highest score from Monday through Sunday close wins a Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo.

qa.q: When does the weekly board reset?
qa.a: Every Monday.

qa.q: When does the weekly contest end?
qa.a: At Sunday close. Last week's champion and a countdown are shown on the champion card in the app.

qa.q: What happens if there is a tie?
qa.a: The score that was posted first wins.

qa.q: What does the weekly champion win?
qa.a: A Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo.

qa.q: Where is my best score saved?
qa.a: Your best score is saved on your phone. Join to save scores and prizes to your account.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use bots?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: Can employees win prizes?
qa.a: Employees and their households can play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: What is the Daily Spin?
qa.a: A free wheel you can spin once a day as a member. Every slice wins something.

qa.q: How often can I spin?
qa.a: Once per member per day, based on Los Angeles time.

qa.q: What can I win on the spin?
qa.a: +100 points, +200 points, +150 points, a free house sauce, $2 off any burger, free fries, or 10% off your order.

qa.q: What are the odds on the spin?
qa.a: +100 pts 30%, +200 pts 20%, +150 pts 15%, free house sauce 15%, $2 off a burger 8%, free fries 7%, 10% off your order 5%.

qa.q: Does the spin cost anything?
qa.a: No. Spins are always free and can't be bought.

qa.q: How long do spin food prizes last?
qa.a: 3 days. They work at either location, one reward per visit, and can't be combined with other rewards.

qa.q: Can I get game tokens?
qa.a: Tokens are not turned on right now. Storm Run is simply free to play.

qa.q: What is on the menu?
qa.a: Combos, burgers (Classic StormBurger, Jalapeño Lightning, Kids Burger, Turkey Burger), a chicken sandwich, chicken strips, fries, onion rings, shakes, lemonade and homemade sauces. See the full menu in the app.

qa.q: How much is a Classic StormBurger Combo?
qa.a: $11.99, with fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: How much is the Jalapeño Lightning Burger?
qa.a: The burger is $6.99, and the combo is $13.99.

qa.q: What is in the Jalapeño Lightning Burger?
qa.a: Homemade avocado crema, Storm sauce, a 4oz patty, Swiss cheese, grilled onions and jalapeños.

qa.q: What is the Turkey Burger?
qa.a: Two 2oz turkey patties with lettuce, tomato, cheese, onions, pickles and burger sauce. It's $6.99.

qa.q: What do you have for kids?
qa.a: A Kids Burger (4oz patty, American cheese) for $5.99, or a Kids Combo with fries and a soft drink for $11.99.

qa.q: How much is the chicken sandwich combo?
qa.a: $12.99, with fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: What comes with a combo?
qa.a: Fries and a soft drink. You can upgrade fries to onion rings for +$2.00 and the drink to a milkshake for +$2.00.

qa.q: What shakes do you have?
qa.a: Vanilla and chocolate, plus a Mix Shake (both) for $4.99.

qa.q: What sauces do you have?
qa.a: Homemade Storm, BBQ, Honey Mustard and Spicy Mayo, $1.00 each. Thunder, Ranch and Avocado Crema are also mentioned in the app.

qa.q: Can I build my own burger?
qa.a: Yes. Use the Build your burger tool in the app. The smash burger starts at $2.74 for a brioche bun and Storm sauce. Patties are $2.50 each, up to 3.

qa.q: What toppings can I add?
qa.a: Extra patties $2.50, American or Swiss cheese $0.75, bacon $2.00, jalapeños $1.00. Lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles and onion straws are free.

qa.q: Can I build a chicken sandwich?
qa.a: Yes. It starts at $2.00 for a brioche bun and mayo. Add a crispy fillet or spicy Thunder fillet ($4.99). Swiss and kale slaw are $0.50.

qa.q: Do you have specials or holiday deals?
qa.a: Yes, seasonal specials appear in the app: Thunder Night Combo (Oct 20–31), Gobble Burger (Nov 20–28), Holiday Shake Stack (Dec 15–25), New Year BBQ Combo (Dec 29–Jan 1), Burgers for Two (Feb 7–14), Lucky Strips Combo (Mar 14–17), Cinco Spicy Combo (May 1–5) and Fourth of July Classic (Jul 1–4).

qa.q: What is the Thunder Night Combo?
qa.a: A Jalapeño Lightning Burger Combo with Thunder sauce on the side, running Oct 20–31. Use code BOO if the app asks for one.

qa.q: Do you have happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have happy hour details. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have daily specials?
qa.a: I only know the holiday specials listed in the app. Ask staff about anything else.

qa.q: Is there a kids mode in the game?
qa.a: I don't have any kid-mode details. Kids under 18 need a parent's permission to join.

qa.q: Do you have trivia or sports features?
qa.a: I don't see trivia or sports in the app, so I can't tell you about them. Ask staff.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Use the 🌐 button at the top right. The usual list is English, Spanish, Chinese (simplified and traditional), Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai and Russian. Restaurant and game names stay in English.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: On iPhone Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, then Add. On Android Chrome: tap Install app, or the ⋮ menu then Add to Home screen.

qa.q: Can I play with a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. Pair a Bluetooth or USB controller, press any button, and use left/right on the stick or D-pad to steer.

qa.q: What are the game settings?
qa.a: You can switch between a 3D chase view and Classic 2D, choose your route (Inglewood, Long Beach, or both), and pick a graphics level.

qa.q: Is there a review video of StormBurger?
qa.a: Yes. Antidote The Foodie reviewed StormBurger. You can find it in the game's bonus billboard and on the end screen, and after about 90 seconds of play you may see a halftime clip.

qa.q: Do you have Instagram?
qa.a: Yes, @stormburger. Posts and reels show in the app.

qa.q: Is my information private?
qa.a: Yes. Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold. Your location stays on your phone.

qa.q: How do I stop texts or emails?
qa.a: Reply STOP to a text or use the unsubscribe link in an email. Marketing texts are optional, and you opt in separately.

qa.q: Where can I read the official game rules?
qa.a: Tap 'Game & daily spin official rules' at the bottom of the app. They are a draft and may change.

qa.q: Can the prizes or rules change?
qa.a: Yes. StormBurger may change or end the game, spin, prizes or rules at any time, with notice in the app.

qa.q: Who do I ask if I need help?
qa.a: Ask a team member at the counter. I don't have a phone number to give you.
